author: gpt-6
plan: Sea dragon sigil with long swept horn, projecting jaw and coiled body. Smooth neck and tail; intentional directional asymmetry. Bounds (6,6)-(42,42).
construction_reference: No useful exact Lucide match; shared geometric construction.
omissions: Double neck outline reduced to one smooth S-shaped stroke to keep the coil open at 48px.
visual_review: Rebuilt the neck and coil as one smooth S-shaped stroke with matched tangents, retaining the swept crest and jaw. Double neck outline simplified for readability. Inspected at native 48px and enlarged size in light and dark themes.
